firstPlayerRule: Choose the first Maestro as the most recent art-gallery visitor, the most experienced player, or a player selected at random.
clarifications: The Maestro leads the first round while the other players draw.
If another round is played, the player to the left of the current Maestro becomes the new Maestro.
